theme: Auditing a supply chain you can only partly see
title: Deep-Tier Blind Spot: Map Before You Audit
strategies: cheapest-visible-audit baseline: audit whichever tier-1 supplier is cheapest to audit, spend nothing else

myopic ratio greedy: repeatedly take the currently-visible map/audit action with the best immediate value/cost ratio, crediting mapping only for its own small self-mitigation (never for what it unlocks)
tier-1-only budget knapsack: optimize the audit selection among direct suppliers only, never map anything
tree-knapsack dynamic program: treat mapping as an investment that opens a children sub-knapsack, solve exactly bottom-up (map/audit/map+audit per node), reconstruct the action sequence top-down
